content.text: {"posting_id":"7337544","verdict":"not_relevant","justification":[{"resume_field":"job_search.target_titles","posting_field":"title","evidence":"Title \"Manager, Sales Development\" contains \"Manager\", which forces a fail, and contains none of Software Engineer, AI Engineer, or Backend Engineer."},{"resume_field":"job_search.target_titles","posting_field":"first_published","evidence":"first_published 2025-10-28 (America/New_York) is 365 days before the run date 2026-10-28, which is more than 21 days."},{"resume_field":"job_search.work_country","posting_field":"location.name","evidence":"Location \"Dublin\" does not show a US location."},{"resume_field":"skills","posting_field":"content","evidence":"None of Python, Java, TypeScript, SQL, PostgreSQL, Spring Boot, React, Docker, or AWS appears as a whole word in the content."},{"resume_field":"job_search.years_experience","posting_field":"content","evidence":"\"2+ years of people management experience\" gives a maximum minimum of 2, which is 3 or less, so this passes."},{"resume_field":"job_search.needs_sponsorship","posting_field":"content","evidence":"No phrases such as \"unable to sponsor\" or \"no sponsorship\" appear in the content, so this passes."}]}
